description: Move the generated protocol bindings and the executor side of buck2's test-runner protocol (launch arguments, inherited-fd sockets, gRPC transport, TestExecutor spec stream) out of src/cmd/turnkey-test-runner into src/rust/buck2-test-executor, so the part pinned to buck2's protocol (TURNKEY_TEST_RUNNER_PROTOCOL, generated-code lint allowances, exact prost/tonic versions) is one crate. Keep runner policy (Config, runner.rs, cache.rs) in the binary. Put a small trait over the three orchestrator calls so run_one can be tested end to end with a fake buck2. No behaviour change: parity suite must still match 3/3.

comments.text: Done in 77590ca02706 (not pushed). New src/rust/buck2-test-executor (bindings + launch/transport/TestExecutor; start(&launch) -> Session { specs, orchestrator, server }). Runner generic over an Orchestrator trait with 5 new fake-buck2 tests (runner: 15 tests, lib: 1). fmt/clippy -D warnings clean, cargo + Buck2 tests pass, Nix package builds, CI gates pass, parity 3/3 on 31 targets.

title: Extract buck2's executor-side test protocol from turnkey-test-runner into a library
